# MediaPipe models

Runtime uses the bundled Hand Landmarker and Pose Landmarker Lite models with MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.21. The same models are used offline to extract reference coordinates. Models are unmodified.

- Hand model: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task
- Pose Lite model: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_lite/float16/1/pose_landmarker_lite.task
- Hand documentation: https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/hand_landmarker
- Pose documentation: https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/pose_landmarker

MediaPipe project: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe . See vendor/mediapipe for the bundled runtime and license notices.
